ShortDescription.Value: Change blue outlines to Any color or transparency. Surface layers on/off, District colors.

Publish.LongDescription:
## Mochi's Hover Colors
### Reduce blue - **1-Click disable**/enable all blue outlines on the fly using the UI panel - Change highlight transparency (alpha) and color. - Works on hover hightlights: buildings, cars, trees, citizens, and more!
### Easier Area Tools - Guidelines: change guide colors and opacity so roads, spacing lines, and previews are easier to see. - Surface tool: hide cloudy preview fill while placing surfaces so you can see the real ground colors. - Specialized Industry: hide extractor lot preview fill. - District tool: change district border and overlay color, adjust opacity, or reset back to vanilla.
### Presets - Tap preset 1 or 2 to switch colors. - Hold preset 1 or 2 (0.5s) to save your current color setup. - Switch button [⇔] swaps between Set A and Set B giving you 4 saved custom color presets. - Restore [↺] toggles between 4 mod default colors and your 4 saved colors.
## Important - Bulldozer and Road-tool color behavior: check the **Options menu!** - Lightweight - no Harmony patches, all vanilla. - To turn Off mod tooltips - see Options Menu. - Darker panel option for Legacy UI or players who prefer darker contrast. - Alpha = transparency; use the last bar on the color picker. - Read the tooltips or Options Menu 3rd panel if you get lost. - Save-game safe and safe to remove any time. - Works with *Recolor* - HC does highlights, guidelines, overlays, previews; Recolor changes object colors. - Performance Optimized: when the panel is closed, it is not doing active work; Change a color, mod does a thing, then goes back idle.
### Feedback - This took many months to overcome many obstacles in game code. - Please share and Like ! -- River Mochi
## ❤️ Special Thanks - **Huge shout out to everyone who tested or supported the mod on its 7 month journey to release.** - Flashbond - collab, tech feedback, testing - yenyang - collab, tech feedback, testing - StarQ - tech feedback, testing - gagaxm - feature idea, testing - Dx, Necko1996, BugsyG, ElGendo87, Maestro - testing - =Noel= Thumbnail, testing - rzzirrah - images1 consultant

Publish.ChangeLog: - 1.0.2 is same as 1.0.1 but PDX didn't update so trying again. - Added Collapsible panel arrow - Resize main color outline swatch, added styling and dot indicator - Added preset Set A / Set B system: P1 and P2 now support 4 saved colors total. - Added separate buttons [⇔] to switch preset between sets A and B - Reset/defaults [↺] button is now non-destructive. Toggles between mod defaults and your saved custom colors (4 colors in each set). - Existing saved P1/P2 presets are preserved as Set A when upgrading. - Updated Game top left icon to a color palette image, and more transparent slider bar. - Tooltips can now only be turned off from the Options menu to prevent accidental shutoff. - Title bar info icon can only turn tooltips back ON but not off (see options menu for OFF). - Improved guideline reapply behavior for better compatibility with Advanced Line Tool mod or any mod that changes GuideLineSettingsData. - Internal refactor and organization.
